How much does an app or website cost?

It depends on what you need. After a short call we send a fixed quote in rupees, so you know the full cost before any work starts. Small websites cost far less than a full app, and we can suggest a smaller first version to fit your budget.
A simple website usually takes one to three weeks. Most apps take one to three months, depending on the features. You will get a clear timeline with your quote.
Will I own the app and the code?
Yes. The code, designs, app store listings and accounts belong to you.
Can you build for both Android and iPhone?
Yes. We usually build both from one shared codebase, which saves time and money.
Do you help after the launch?
Yes. We fix launch issues quickly and offer monthly care plans for updates and new features.
We usually split payment into stages: a part to start, a part after design approval and the rest at launch.

QR Menu and Billing Software for Restaurants in India | mahinova
QR menu, kitchen screen, GST billing and sales reports for restaurants and cafes, in English and Bangla. Plans from Rs 499 a month with a 14-day free trial.
Do guests need to download an app?
No. Guests just scan the QR code and the menu opens in their phone's browser. Staff can install the staff screens on a phone or tablet from the browser, like an app.
What do we need to start?
A phone, tablet or computer for the counter, and one for the kitchen if you want the kitchen screen. We set up your menu, tables and QR cards with you.
Which printer does it work with?
Bills print through the browser on 80 mm and 58 mm receipt printers or on A4 paper.
What if the internet goes down?
Table orders taken while the internet is down are saved on the device and sent when it is back. Settling a bill needs the internet.
Is our data safe and separate?
Yes. Every restaurant's data is kept apart from every other restaurant's, and staff only see what their role allows.
Yes. Ask for a free demo, and new restaurants get a 14-day free trial with everything switched on before they decide.
